title: StrokeSmriti: a multilingual, offline, clinician-administered assessment of cognitive outcomes after stroke and stroke procedures
description: Free phone and tablet tool for measuring cognition after stroke, thrombectomy, thrombolysis and carotid or intracranial revascularisation in India. Eight languages, read-aloud instructions, pointing versions for aphasia and limited literacy, three parallel forms, procedure-anchored timepoints and process measures. Research use only; not yet validated. Software under MIT; instrument content under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
